<?php
/**
 * Email Service with Attachment Processing
 * Handles user-uploaded files as email attachments
 * Uses custom resource pool for memory efficiency
 */

class AttachmentResource {
    private $handle;
    private $metadata;
    private $refCount;
    private static $pool = [];
    
    public function __construct(string $path, array $meta) {
        $this->handle = fopen($path, 'rb');
        $this->metadata = $meta;
        $this->refCount = 1;
        self::$pool[spl_object_id($this)] = $this;
    }
    
    public function addRef(): void {
        $this->refCount++;
    }
    
    public function release(): bool {
        $this->refCount--;
        if ($this->refCount <= 0) {
            $this->destroy();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function destroy(): void {
        if (is_resource($this->handle)) {
            fclose($this->handle);
        }
        $this->handle = null;
        $this->metadata = null;
        unset(self::$pool[spl_object_id($this)]);
    }
    
    public function getContent(): string {
        if (!is_resource($this->handle)) {
            return '';
        }
        rewind($this->handle);
        return stream_get_contents($this->handle);
    }
    
    public function getMeta(): ?array {
        return $this->metadata;
    }
    
    public function isValid(): bool {
        return is_resource($this->handle);
    }
}

class AttachmentValidator {
    private const MAX_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
    private const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf', 'text/plain'];
    
    public function validate(AttachmentResource $resource): ValidationResult {
        $meta = $resource->getMeta();
        if ($meta === null) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, 'Invalid resource');
        }
        
        if ($meta['size'] > self::MAX_SIZE) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, 'File too large');
        }
        
        if (!in_array($meta['mime_type'], self::ALLOWED_TYPES, true)) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, 'Disallowed file type');
        }
        
        // Perform content-based validation
        $content = $resource->getContent();
        if (strlen($content) === 0) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, 'Empty content');
        }
        
        return new ValidationResult(true, 'OK');
    }
}

class ValidationResult {
    public bool $valid;
    public string $message;
    
    public function __construct(bool $valid, string $message) {
        $this->valid = $valid;
        $this->message = $message;
    }
}

class EmailComposer {
    private array $attachments = [];
    private array $pendingResources = [];
    
    public function addAttachment(AttachmentResource $resource, string $filename): void {
        $resource->addRef();
        $this->pendingResources[] = $resource;
        $this->attachments[] = [
            'resource' => $resource,
            'filename' => $this->sanitizeFilename($filename),
        ];
    }
    
    public function buildMessage(string $to, string $subject, string $body): array {
        $message = [
            'to' => filter_var($to, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) ? $to : null,
            'subject' => htmlspecialchars($subject, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
            'body' => htmlspecialchars($body, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
            'attachments' => [],
        ];
        
        if ($message['to'] === null) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid email address');
        }
        
        foreach ($this->attachments as $att) {
            $content = $att['resource']->getContent();
            $message['attachments'][] = [
                'filename' => $att['filename'],
                'content' => base64_encode($content),
                'size' => strlen($content),
            ];
        }
        
        return $message;
    }
    
    public function cleanup(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingResources as $resource) {
            $resource->release();
        }
        $this->pendingResources = [];
        $this->attachments = [];
    }
    
    private function sanitizeFilename(string $filename): string {
        $filename = basename($filename);
        $filename = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', $filename);
        return substr($filename, 0, 255);
    }
}

class EmailService {
    private AttachmentValidator $validator;
    private EmailComposer $composer;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->validator = new AttachmentValidator();
        $this->composer = new EmailComposer();
    }
    
    public function processAndSend(array $uploadedFiles, string $to, string $subject, string $body): array {
        $resources = [];
        $errors = [];
        
        foreach ($uploadedFiles as $file) {
            if (!isset($file['tmp_name']) || !is_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'])) {
                $errors[] = 'Invalid upload';
                continue;
            }
            
            $meta = [
                'original_name' => $file['name'] ?? 'unnamed',
                'size' => $file['size'] ?? 0,
                'mime_type' => $this->detectMimeType($file['tmp_name']),
            ];
            
            $resource = new AttachmentResource($file['tmp_name'], $meta);
            $resources[] = $resource;
        }
        
        // Phase 1: Validate all resources
        $validResources = [];
        foreach ($resources as $idx => $resource) {
            $result = $this->validator->validate($resource);
            if ($result->valid) {
                $validResources[] = ['resource' => $resource, 'idx' => $idx];
            } else {
                $errors[] = "File {$idx}: {$result->message}";
                $resource->release();
            }
        }
        
        // Phase 2: Scan for malware (simulated async callback pattern)
        $scannedResources = $this->malwareScan($validResources);
        
        // Phase 3: Compose email with surviving attachments
        foreach ($scannedResources as $item) {
            $meta = $item['resource']->getMeta();
            $filename = $meta['original_name'] ?? 'attachment';
            $this->composer->addAttachment($item['resource'], $filename);
        }
        
        try {
            $message = $this->composer->buildMessage($to, $subject, $body);
        } finally {
            // Release original references
            foreach ($resources as $resource) {
                $resource->release();
            }
            $this->composer->cleanup();
        }
        
        return ['success' => empty($errors), 'errors' => $errors, 'message' => $message ?? null];
    }
    
    private function malwareScan(array $items): array {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $content = $item['resource']->getContent();
            // Simulated scan: reject if contains EICAR test string
            if (strpos($content, 'X5O!P%@AP[4\\PZX54(P^)7CC)7}$EICAR') !== false) {
                $item['resource']->release();
                continue;
            }
            $clean[] = $item;
        }
        return $clean;
    }
    
    private function detectMimeType(string $path): string {
        $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        return $finfo->file($path) ?: 'application/octet-stream';
    }
}

// Entry point
function handleEmailRequest(): void {
    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
        http_response_code(405);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Method not allowed']);
        return;
    }
    
    $to = $_POST['to'] ?? '';
    $subject = $_POST['subject'] ?? '';
    $body = $_POST['body'] ?? '';
    $files = $_FILES['attachments'] ?? [];
    
    // Normalize files array
    $normalized = [];
    if (isset($files['tmp_name'])) {
        if (is_array($files['tmp_name'])) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < count($files['tmp_name']); $i++) {
                $normalized[] = [
                    'tmp_name' => $files['tmp_name'][$i],
                    'name' => $files['name'][$i] ?? 'file',
                    'size' => $files['size'][$i] ?? 0,
                ];
            }
        } else {
            $normalized[] = $files;
        }
    }
    
    $service = new EmailService();
    $result = $service->processAndSend($normalized, $to, $subject, $body);
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}

handleEmailRequest();
